title: Actions related to transmission of NotificationMessageSidelink message

entities.name: NotificationMessageSidelink
entities.description: A sidelink message transmitted by a U2N Relay UE to notify about various events.

entities.name: indicationType
entities.description: An information element in the NotificationMessageSidelink that indicates the reason for transmission.

entities.name: Uu RLF condition
entities.description: Condition when UE initiates transmission due to Uu Radio Link Failure.

entities.name: Reconfiguration with sync condition
entities.description: Condition when UE initiates transmission due to reconfiguration with synchronization.

entities.name: Cell reselection condition
entities.description: Condition when UE initiates transmission due to cell reselection.

entities.name: Uu RRC connection establishment failure condition
entities.description: Condition when UE initiates transmission due to Uu RRC connection establishment failure.

entities.name: relayUE-UuRLF
entities.description: Value set for indicationType when transmission is due to Uu RLF.

entities.name: relayUE-HO
entities.description: Value set for indicationType when transmission is due to reconfiguration with sync.

entities.name: relayUE-CellReselection
entities.description: Value set for indicationType when transmission is due to cell reselection.

entities.name: relayUE-UuRRCFailure
entities.description: Value set for indicationType when transmission is due to Uu RRC connection establishment failure.

relations.description: The NotificationMessageSidelink message contains the indicationType information element.
When transmission is due to Uu RLF, the indicationType is set to relayUE-UuRLF.
When transmission is due to reconfiguration with sync, the indicationType is set to relayUE-HO.
When transmission is due to cell reselection, the indicationType is set to relayUE-CellReselection.
When transmission is due to Uu RRC connection establishment failure, the indicationType is set to relayUE-UuRRCFailure.
The value of indicationType is determined by the condition of Uu RLF.
The value of indicationType is determined by the condition of reconfiguration with sync.
The value of indicationType is determined by the condition of cell reselection.
The value of indicationType is determined by the condition of Uu RRC connection establishment failure.
